summary: Frontend-only validation of the 3 recent dashboard changes for Coach in LordTraining (preview env, super admin login). Verified: (1) Chart legend toggle works — clicking a legend item hides the series (series count 3→2 in 'Volumen, Intensidad y Densidad' chart) and clicking again restores it (2→3). Visual atenuado is achieved through the recharts default icon greying. (2) Plan badge in sidebar (expanded) renders correctly — 3/3 plans show data-testid='plan-badge' with the correct auto-assigned colors (Boxeo→red #EF4444, Judo→orange #F97316). When sidebar is collapsed, 3/3 'sidebar-collapsed-plan-<id>' elements render with embedded plan-badge (no name initials anymore). (3) Subtitle in sidebar correctly shows sport NAMES (Boxeo, Judo) — NOT UUIDs. BUG FOUND: the MODEL name in the Judo plan subtitle still shows a UUID '40422f46-4ce2-4fc8-b1f9-c1ad5c79911f' instead of a readable model name, in BOTH the sidebar plan card AND the dashboard 'PLAN ACTIVO' tile. Wizard plan icon picker (plan-icon-picker / wizard-plan-icon) was NOT reachable — clicking 'sidebar-create-plan-btn' did not navigate the page (URL stayed at /dashboard, no picker rendered). GraphicPlan header was also not reachable from the simple plan-click path used (the plan-click sets the active plan on the dashboard rather than opening a plan detail view with a 'Plan Gráfico' tab).

ui_bugs.issue: Model name for the Judo plan renders as raw UUID '40422f46-4ce2-4fc8-b1f9-c1ad5c79911f' instead of a readable name like 'Ondulada Avanzada (Zourdos)'. Appears in sidebar plan subtitle AND in the 'PLAN ACTIVO' dashboard tile when that plan is selected.

After selecting the Judo plan from sidebar, the tile still shows the label 'Sin plan seleccionado' at the top while displaying the selected plan's data (4 sem, model UUID) below it. Stale placeholder label.

Clicking [data-testid="sidebar-create-plan-btn"] did not open the wizard (URL remained /dashboard, no [data-testid="plan-icon-picker"] nor [data-testid="wizard-plan-icon"] rendered in the DOM after click+timeouts). Could be: (a) plans Sheet closes on click and the route is not navigated, or (b) the picker is only shown after filling earlier wizard steps. Could not validate the PlanIconPicker integration in the wizard.

integration_issues.issue: Sport id → name resolution works (sport UUID is mapped to 'Judo'/'Boxeo'), but model id → name resolution is missing/failing for at least one custom periodization model (id 40422f46-4ce2-4fc8-b1f9-c1ad5c79911f). Likely the /api/periodization-library response does not contain this id, or PlanSidebar's getModelName/getSportName helpers fall back to the raw id when not found instead of a graceful 'Modelo personalizado' label.

issues: The toggle works (series hide/show), but the legend text itself does NOT receive a CSS line-through/atenuado style on the wrapper. The visual cue is only the legend ICON greying. The original spec said 'el texto de la leyenda se ve tachado/atenuado' — consider adding a text-decoration:line-through or opacity to the legend label span when hiddenSeries.has(dataKey).

action_items: FIX (HIGH): Resolve model name for plan id 8b945365-... (Judo plan). PlanSidebar should call its getModelName(plan.model) and fall back to a friendly label instead of the raw UUID when the id is not in /api/periodization-library. Same fix needed in the Dashboard 'PLAN ACTIVO' card.

FIX (HIGH): The dashboard 'PLAN ACTIVO' tile shows BOTH 'Sin plan seleccionado' and the active plan data simultaneously after selection — clean up the conditional rendering so the placeholder hides once a plan is selected.

INVESTIGATE (HIGH): 'Nuevo Plan' / 'sidebar-create-plan-btn' did not open the wizard from the Planes Sheet for the super admin. Verify the click handler actually navigates to the PeriodizationComplete route (and that the Sheet doesn't intercept/close). Once wizard reachable, re-test plan-icon-picker, plan-icon-grid, plan-emoji-grid, plan-color-palette and preview update on data-testid="plan-badge".
MINOR: Add a visual atenuado/line-through to the legend TEXT (not just the icon) in InteractiveChart when the series is hidden, to match the spec.
ACCESSIBILITY (low): Two console warnings 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' on dashboard load — add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to those dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: PlanSidebar resolves SPORT correctly via getSportName prop but the MODEL resolution appears to fall back to the raw plan.model UUID instead of a friendly placeholder. Defensive fallback recommended: `const modelName = models[plan.model]?.name || plan.model_name || 'Modelo personalizado'`.

PlanIconPicker.jsx and lib/planIcons.js look clean and correctly expose all required data-testids (plan-icon-picker, plan-icon-tab-icon, plan-icon-tab-emoji, plan-icon-grid, plan-emoji-grid, plan-color-palette, plan-icon-opt-<key>, plan-color-opt-<hex>, plan-emoji-opt-<emoji>, plan-badge). autoIconForSport maps Boxeo→swords/#EF4444 ✓ and Judo→shield/#F97316 ✓ — confirmed matching the rendered badge backgrounds.

InteractiveChart toggleSeries logic works for hide/show (series count went 3→2→3 in DOM); however the legend formatter does not visibly cross out the text — only the lucide/default recharts icon greys. Consider wrapping the text in a <span style={{textDecoration: hidden ? 'line-through' : 'none', opacity: hidden ? 0.5 : 1}}>.
PlanSidebar collapsed view now correctly renders data-testid="sidebar-collapsed-plan-<id>" with an embedded plan-badge — no more name-initial badges. Good.
Two duplicate-toaster style mounts persist (carried over from iteration 91 — DialogTitle warnings appear twice on each dashboard load).

success_rate.frontend: 60% — legend toggle PASS, sidebar plan-badge expanded+collapsed PASS, sport name resolution PASS; model name UUID bug FAIL, wizard picker not reachable FAIL, PLAN ACTIVO stale label FAIL

seed_data_creation: None. The super admin already had 3 plans (2 Boxeo+ATR, 1 Judo+custom-model).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login as super admin → click 'Planes' nav button (top bar) to open the plans Sheet. The 3 plans are: Boxeo+ATR (id 25b9abc7...), Judo+custom-model (id 8b945365..., MODEL UUID = 40422f46-4ce2-4fc8-b1f9-c1ad5c79911f) and Boxeo+ATR copy (id b55f151e...). To reproduce the UUID-in-subtitle bug, look at the Judo plan card in the sidebar OR click it and observe the dashboard PLAN ACTIVO tile. To re-test the wizard picker after the main agent fixes the create-plan navigation, click [data-testid='sidebar-create-plan-btn'] and probe for [data-testid='plan-icon-picker'] / [data-testid='wizard-plan-icon']; the picker exposes plan-icon-tab-icon, plan-icon-tab-emoji, plan-icon-grid, plan-emoji-grid, plan-color-palette and plan-icon-opt-<key> / plan-emoji-opt-<emoji> / plan-color-opt-<#hex>. Legend toggle: open any chart on the dashboard, query .recharts-legend-item nodes, click the first one and verify .recharts-layer.recharts-line/.recharts-bar/.recharts-area count decreases by 1, then click again to restore.
rca_of_the_issue: Model-name UUID leak: the Judo plan was created against a custom/non-catalog periodization model (id 40422f46-...). PlanSidebar (and the Dashboard PLAN ACTIVO card) read plan.model and look it up in a map built from GET /api/periodization-library. When the id is not in that library response, the code falls back to plan.model (the raw UUID) instead of plan.model_name or a friendly fallback. Fix in PlanSidebar.js + Dashboard PLAN ACTIVO + GraphicPlan.js: `const modelName = libraryById[plan.model]?.name || plan?.model_name || plan?.periodization_type_name || 'Modelo personalizado';`. Also verify the backend includes a denormalized `model_name` field on the training-plan response so the frontend never has to depend on a separate fetch. PLAN ACTIVO 'Sin plan seleccionado' overlay: probable conditional render mistake — the header text is rendered unconditionally while the content below uses activePlan; should be `{activePlan ? activePlan.name : 'Sin plan seleccionado'}`. Wizard not reachable: most likely the plans Sheet closes/unmounts on internal click before the route push runs; needs investigation in PlanSidebar.js → sidebar-create-plan-btn onClick handler.
